connector.name: Cvserver
connector.registryDescription: Live US options chains with Greeks and IV, a screener, SQL, and FMP fundamentals.
connector.summary: Hosted at tap.convexvalue.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.convexvalue, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <cvforge API key>. Create one free at https://cvforge.convexvalue.com/account — the free plan includes this server at 20 requests/hour.
